intent: 明亮人物与轻侧暗；撤回大面积半脸紫影方向。只把patch字段递归合并进主profile，由总任务负责实际渲染。
limits: Default module directional_fill.enabled remains false; v1 settings retain their active graph.
Only Ikhor main-face analytic form accepts directional_fill. Aksiniya original SDF, nose repair and all facial features remain upstream and untouched.
Face fill uses the physical fill object's WORLD position as an artistic direction, even while its real diffuse_factor stays zero.
Filled form is keyForm + strength * fillBand * (1-keyForm), before existing combined response and AO. There is no final face brightness floor.
Tint affects only the bounded fill contribution and is gated by combined response and proxy enable; it preserves palette alpha one.
The suggested head-space key/fill placement is frozen at the chosen build frame; continuous motion and final appearance need the root render review.
